summary_en: Size not disclosed. Atrae updated its capital-cost and share-price management framework via board resolution on 2026-07-10. Detailed metrics and targets deferred to attached materials.
title_en: Update on initiatives toward realizing capital-cost and share-price conscious management
translation_en_brief: Atrae announced an update to its capital-cost and share-price management framework on 2026-07-10 via board resolution. The company stated that it has been disclosing its analysis, policies, and specific initiatives through earnings briefing materials. The specific targets, metrics, and operational measures are contained in attached materials not reproduced in the press release text provided. No quantitative details (share repurchase size, dividend targets, ROE/margin benchmarks, or payout-ratio floors) are visible in the cover page.
